item.title: docs(whatsapp): document the canonical ack reaction keys (#118161)
item.summary: docs(whatsapp): document the canonical ack reaction keys (#118161) * docs(channels): record the WhatsApp ack-reaction exceptions The shared reference promises channel and account ackReaction overrides plus an identity fallback for every channel, but only Discord, Matrix, Slack, and Telegram accept those keys, and WhatsApp sends no acknowledgment at all when messages.ackReaction is unset. Also notes that group activation always bypasses the group-mentions mention check. * docs(whatsapp): qualify the ack-reaction exception The eligibility path reads the account-aware channels.whatsapp.reactionLevel before the message settings, so "only" applies to the emoji and scope rather than to the whole decision. * docs(whatsapp): describe supported ack reaction overrides precisely --------- Co-authored-by: Peter Steinberger
